name: Eufy Video Doorbell S330 - Dual Camera Smart Doorbell (2K + Package Cam)
short_description: Smart doorbell with two cameras: 2K main camera and a dedicated lower package camera. Local storage with no monthly subscription. Built-in battery with optional wired installation. Works with HomeBase 3.

name: Ajax Hub 2 Plus - Professional Wireless Smart Alarm System
short_description: Smart alarm hub supporting up to 200 devices. Dual connectivity (Ethernet + 2x SIM) with 15-hour backup battery. Advanced anti-jamming and anti-tamper. Supports cameras and visual verification.

name: Reolink 16-Channel PoE NVR (RLN16-410) - 4K Network Video Recorder
short_description: 16-channel NVR supporting cameras up to 12MP. Built-in 16 PoE ports power cameras directly. Supports up to 12TB HDD. No monthly subscription.

name: Ubiquiti UniFi Protect G4 Doorbell Pro - 5MP Smart Doorbell with Fingerprint Reader
short_description: Smart video doorbell with 5MP camera, night vision, and built-in fingerprint reader. On-device LCD screen for visitor messages. Works with UniFi Protect with no monthly subscription.

name: Hikvision DS-2CD2143G2-I - 4MP AcuSense Dome Camera
short_description: Indoor/outdoor 4MP dome camera with AcuSense AI detection. 2.8mm lens with 103° angle and 30-meter night vision. Vandal-proof IK10 design with PoE power.

name: Reolink Argus 4 Pro - Solar-Powered Wireless 4K Security Camera
short_description: Fully wireless 4K security camera with integrated solar panel. Color night vision and AI smart detection. Built-in battery charges via solar. No wires needed whatsoever.

name: Reolink RLC-810A - 4K PoE AI Security Camera
short_description: Outdoor 4K (8MP) security camera with PoE power over Ethernet. AI-powered person and vehicle detection. 30-meter night vision. Local storage on microSD or NVR.
